items.title: WIRED: AI-produced Riemann hypothesis solution challenges human comprehension
items.description: WIRED reports that an Anthropic researcher produced a 17-million-line solution to the Riemann hypothesis that mathematicians will need months to understand, described as 'alien'.

items.title: The Register: InferNode revives Bell Labs' Inferno OS for 64-bit systems
items.description: The Register reports that InferNode gives Bell Labs' Inferno OS, Plan 9's successor, a 64-bit update, with a new role containing AI agents that its developer says are optional features.

items.title: UK government invests in defense startup building virtual training ground for military AI
items.description: The Register reports the UK government has invested in a defense startup building a virtual training ground intended to test whether military AI will work before real-world deployment, as part of a push for sovereign capability.

items.title: Signal joins United Airlines and banks in limiting AI agents over customer risks
items.description: CNBC reports that privacy-focused messaging app Signal has joined United Airlines and JPMorgan Chase in implementing restrictions around artificial intelligence agents, citing customer risks.

items.title: Meta launches Muse AI agent in the UK for task-based shopping and booking
items.description: The Guardian reports Meta is launching its Muse AI assistant in the UK, letting users give agents tasks such as booking travel or buying presents, with glitches reported. The outlet says Muse has been a hit in the US, ranking first and second on Google and Apple's free app stores with millions of downloads.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock launches Trusted Access API with Anthropic enterprise safeguard programs in public preview
items.description: AWS announces a Bedrock trusted access program API for discovering, requesting, and enrolling in model provider programs. The first two public-preview offerings are Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards and Enterprise Data Controls for Claude Fable models.

items.title: datasette-charts 0.2a0 adds agent integration for chat-driven chart creation
items.description: The author describes a new Datasette charting plugin release that integrates with Datasette Agent, letting users request charts in chat. A demo video shows prompting the agent, inline chart display, opening a chart builder panel, and the agent describing chart changes.

items.title: datasette-agent 0.7a1 improves iframe side panel navigation by fragment hashes
items.description: The author describes a Datasette Agent release letting chat sessions open an iframe side panel that can navigate pages, with improved fragment-hash navigation for plugin state changes. It was built to fix bugs in the datasette-charts release.

items.title: LinkedIn post compares Standard, Graph and Agentic RAG architectures and when to use each
items.description: The post outlines trade-offs among Standard RAG for speed, Graph RAG for relationship-heavy knowledge, and Agentic RAG for multi-step planning, noting Graph RAG's higher build and maintenance costs. It argues the key question is choosing or combining architectures.

items.title: Databricks announces catalog labels for sharing catalog metadata across platforms, engines, and agents.
items.description: The Databricks Blog announces support for catalog labels, described as a new capability in the Apache ecosystem for sharing catalog metadata across data platforms, engines, and agents.

items.title: Z.ai releases GLM 5.4, its first model using a looped transformer architecture
items.description: The blog post reports that Chinese AI lab Z.ai has released GLM 5.4, described as its first looped transformer model, in which weight-shared layers run multiple iterations per forward pass. The author notes it is the second looped transformer mentioned recently, after Thinking Machines Lab's Inkling 2 Mini.

items.title: Commentary argues AI agents make the lack of shared business meaning more visible
items.description: The article argues that AI needs not just access to enterprise information but the definitions, relationships and rules that make it meaningful, and that AI agents have raised the stakes of missing shared business meaning.

items.title: TechCrunch: Anthropic launches Claude Ship for AI agents to review and approve code changes
items.description: TechCrunch reports Anthropic launched Claude Ship, developer tools that let AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes. The article frames this as addressing bottlenecks from accumulating AI-generated code.

items.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
items.description: Ars Technica reports that state attorneys general are suing SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sexual abuse images and revenge porn, while X says every Grok output is screened.

items.title: Article traces RAG's origins from REALM to the 2020 Lewis et al. paper and retrieval baselines
items.description: The article recounts how REALM and the RAG paper addressed models holding facts only in weights, introducing retrievers over document collections, and criticizes vendor-focused RAG coverage that omits baselines and retrieval records.
